description: ERC20 token balance for any wallet on Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon via balanceOf (eth_call). Returns raw + decimal-formatted balance, symbol, decimals, block. Example: {address:"0xd8dA…6045", token:"0x8335…2913", chain:"base"}. $0.001.

Native coin balance (ETH/POL) of any address via eth_getBalance, optionally at a historical block. Example: {address:"0xd8dA…6045", chain:"ethereum"} → {balance:"…", balance_wei, block}. Use /wallet ($0.003) for native + major tokens in one call. $0.001.

Live wallet balance — native ETH/POL plus up to 20 caller-supplied ERC20 tokens in one RPC batch (balanceOf + decimals + symbol). No hardcoded majors (use /wallet $0.003 for USDC/USDT/DAI/WETH pack). Example: {address:"0xd8dA…6045", tokens:"0xdAC1…1ec7,0xA0b8…eB48", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002.

Latest block height (chain tip) plus safe/finalized heights and head age in seconds, via eth_blockNumber/eth_getBlockByNumber. Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon. Example: {chain:"base"}. $0.001.

Next transaction nonce for any address (latest and pending) via eth_getTransactionCount — how many txs it has sent, and whether one is stuck in the mempool. Example: {address:"0xd8dA…6045", chain:"base"}. $0.001.
Total supply of an ERC20 or ERC721 token via totalSupply (eth_call), formatted with decimals and symbol. Example: {token:"0x8335…2913", chain:"base"} → {total_supply, symbol, decimals}. $0.001.

ERC20 Transfer events for a token and/or wallet via eth_getLogs, decoded (from, to, amount with decimals, tx hash, block). Default last 100 blocks, max 5000. Public RPCs need a contract filter: pass token=; if only wallet address is given, known chain tokens (USDC/WETH/…) are scanned. Example: {token:"0x8335…2913", address:"0x88b1…3ff6", chain:"base"}. $0.003.

params.token: ERC20 contract (recommended; required unless scanning known tokens for a wallet)
params.address: Wallet to filter (optional if token given)

description: Contract event logs via eth_getLogs filtered by contract and topics (topic0 = event signature hash). Raw logs, newest first; default last 100 blocks, max 5000 (auto-chunked for public RPC limits). Example: {address:"0x8335…2913", topic0:"0xddf2…b3ef", chain:"base", blocks:"50"}. $0.003.
EVM network info in one call: chain ID, client version, block height, head age, gas price, base fee, native symbol. Confirms which chain an RPC is on before signing. Example: {chain:"base"}. $0.001.

Transaction receipt via eth_getTransactionReceipt: success/revert status, gas used, effective gas price, fee in native coin, contract created, log count + raw logs. Example: {hash:"0x…", chain:"base"}. Use /tx ($0.003) for decoded transfers + confirmations. $0.002.

Is this address a contract or a wallet (EOA)? eth_getCode → is_contract, bytecode size and prefix, EIP-7702 delegation detection. Example: {address:"0x8335…2913", chain:"base"}. Use /contract ($0.003) for proxy/owner/token detail. $0.001.

Read-only contract call via eth_call (no transaction sent): pass to + ABI-encoded data, get the raw return hex plus best-effort uint/address/string decodes and revert reason. Example: {to:"0x8335…2913", data:"0x18160ddd", chain:"base"}. $0.002.

Estimate gas for a transaction before signing (eth_estimateGas) plus current fee → cost in native coin; returns the revert reason if it would fail. Example: {from:"0xd8dA…6045", to:"0x8335…2913", data:"0xa9059cbb…", chain:"base"}. $0.002.

Current owner of an ERC721 token_id via ownerOf (eth_call), plus collection name/symbol. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…f13D", token_id:"1", chain:"ethereum"} → {owner}. Use /nft ($0.002) for metadata. $0.001.

ERC721/1155 tokenURI/uri + resolved JSON metadata (IPFS/Arweave/data URI) plus collection name/symbol. Does not require ownerOf — use when explorers ask for /chain/nft-metadata. Prefer /nft ($0.002) when you also need current owner; /chain/nft-owner ($0.001) for owner only. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…f13D", token_id:"1", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002.

List every ERC721 token_id a wallet owns in a collection via balanceOf + tokenOfOwnerByIndex (ERC721Enumerable). Caps at limit (default 50, max 100). If the collection is not enumerable, returns is_enumerable:false with balance. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…f13D", address:"0x46ef…2496", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002.
ERC1155 balance: how many copies of token_id a wallet holds, via balanceOf(address,uint256) (eth_call). Example: {contract:"0x…", address:"0x…", token_id:"1", chain:"base"}. $0.001.

Read a raw storage slot of any contract via eth_getStorageAt, with uint and address decodes. Example: {address:"0x8335…2913", slot:"0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc", chain:"base"} (EIP-1967 implementation slot). $0.001.

Detect upgradeable proxies (EIP-1967 transparent/UUPS, beacon, legacy OZ, EIP-1167 minimal clones, EIP-7702) via eth_getStorageAt/eth_getCode: implementation, admin, beacon, and whether the implementation is a live contract. Example: {address:"0x8335…2913", chain:"base"}. $0.002.
EIP-155 chain ID straight from the RPC (eth_chainId + net_version) — confirm which network you are about to sign on. Example: {chain:"base"} → {chain_id:8453}. $0.001.

Pending + latest block snapshot via eth_getBlockByNumber: pending number/hash/parentHash/timestamp/gas/baseFee/tx count/miner vs latest head age. Public RPCs may omit pending — then 502. Example: {chain:"base"}. $0.001.
